title: General account question
summary: Customer asks when support is open on Saturdays.
customer_message: Hi! What time is Northstar support open on Saturdays?
expected_reason: General question covered by ANSWER_DIRECT; no rule requires a human.

title: Duplicate charge
summary: Customer reports being charged twice for one month.
customer_message: I just checked my statement and I was charged $42.50 twice on October 3 for my monthly plan. My account is NS-20417. Please fix this.
account_context: Account NS-20417, Standard plan, $42.50/month. Billing log shows two charges of $42.50 dated 2026-10-03. The log does not show whether either charge is a pending authorization or both have posted.
expected_reason: DUPLICATE_CHARGE requires a human; NO_REFUND_PROMISE forbids promising money back.

unknowns.label: Whether a charge is pending or posted

title: Refund above approval threshold
summary: Customer requests a $150 refund for an unused add-on.
customer_message: I'd like a refund of $150 for the annual Premium Insights add-on I bought last week. I never used it. Order number NS-ORD-7781.
account_context: Order NS-ORD-7781: Premium Insights annual add-on, $150.00, purchased 2026-10-21. Usage data for the add-on is not available to the agent.
expected_reason: REFUND_OVER_100 requires human approval; the agent must not claim a refund was issued.

unknowns.label: Whether the add-on was actually used

title: Suspected fraud
customer_message: There's a $389.99 charge from 'TechMart Online' on my account from yesterday that I definitely did not make. Account NS-55102. What is going on?
account_context: Account NS-55102. Transaction log shows $389.99 to TechMart Online on 2026-10-28. No information is available about how the payment was authorized.

required_facts.label: Customer did not make the charge

prohibited_claims.label: Claims the account or card was locked/secured

title: Explicit human request
summary: Frustrated customer asks for a real person.
customer_message: This is the third time I'm contacting you about downgrading my internet plan. I want to talk to a real person, not a bot.
account_context: Account NS-31876. An open plan-downgrade ticket exists from 2026-10-12. The ticket does not record which plan the customer wants to move to.
expected_reason: HUMAN_REQUESTED: the customer explicitly asked for a person.

title: Upset customer, routine fix
summary: Angry customer needs a password reset. No rule requires a human.
customer_message: This is ridiculous. Your app logged me out AGAIN and now I can't remember my password. How do I reset it?
expected_reason: UPSET_NOT_ESCALATION: frustration alone is not a reason; the question is answerable.

required_facts.label: Reset path (Settings > Security or Forgot password)
